question: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. A lives on floor number 5. Only two people live between A and C. Neither D nor B lives on the topmost floor. E lives immediately below C. B does not live on an even-numbered floor. Who lives on floor number 3?
solution:
